question: Which eight-syllabled great mantra is invoked to protect the arms?
premises: protection of the arms is requested
the protector is an eight-syllabled great knowledge
it is described as accompanied by an agent
inference: the eight-syllabled great knowledge, accompanied by its agent, protects the arms
uncertainties: precise referent of sakartṛkā is not specified in this unit
plain_english: May the eight-syllabled great knowledge, together with its agent, protect my arms.
